title: My Three Sons Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Incredible porches up and down length of home; outdoor dining and lounge area. Large, fenced yard, two generous porches, & two king bedrooms with ensuite baths! Sleeps 10, great location, "My Three Sons"!
description_expanded: Description665 Forest Street2 KINGS, 2 BUNK BEDS, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 10)Classic Seaside Cottage on Forest StreetWelcome to My Three Sons, a charming Seaside vacation home ideally located on Forest Street, just two blocks from the West Side Pool and a short walk to the West Ruskin Pavilion beach access. This central Seaside location places you within easy walking distance of the Seaside Amphitheater, Airstream Row, Ruskin Park, and the beach—making it an excellent choice for families seeking both relaxation and convenience in Seaside, Florida.Exceptional Outdoor Living SpacesMy Three Sons is designed for outdoor living, offering multiple porches and gathering spaces that truly set this home apart. Start your mornings on the wide-open front porch, furnished with Adirondack seating for four and overlooking the white picket–fenced yard. A second-floor porch runs the full length of the home, creating an elevated retreat with views of Seaside’s treetops and townscape.Just off the kitchen, the screened-in porch features a dining table for six and a fun bar area with seating for two. From there, step onto a spacious open-air balcony with lounge seating and a swing—perfect for family meals, card games, or winding down after a day at the beach.First-Floor Bedrooms with Private BathsThe first level of the home offers three thoughtfully designed bedrooms, each with its own bathroom—ideal for families or groups traveling together. The king primary suite includes a chaise lounge, a large mounted flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with an updated glass-enclosed walk-in shower.The second bedroom is a bunk room sleeping four, complete with a small flat-screen TV and French doors that open directly onto the front porch. The adjacent bathroom features a tub and shower combination with glass enclosure. The third bedroom is another king suite, offering ample storage, a dresser, a mounted flat-screen TV, and a newly updated ensuite bathroom with marble countertops, a single vanity, and a walk-in shower.Open-Concept Living on the Second FloorUpstairs, vaulted ceilings and an open floor plan create a bright, airy space that seamlessly blends the kitchen, dining, and living areas. French doors lead out to the expansive second-floor porch, where you can enjoy treetop views and the relaxed pace of Seaside living.The living area is furnished with large sofas, including a queen sleeper sofa, and a mounted flat-screen TV. The renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, new countertops, a large sink, and everything needed for preparing meals at home. The central dining table comfortably seats eight, with additional outdoor dining for six on the porch. A convenient half bath is located just off the kitchen.Thoughtful Extras for a Relaxing StayAdditional amenities include an enclosed outdoor shower, a charcoal grill, a full-size washer and dryer, and a spacious fenced courtyard—ideal for relaxing after sandy beach days. With its unbeatable location, generous outdoor spaces, and family-friendly layout, My Three Sons delivers a classic and comfortable Seaside vacation experience.* 5-night minimum Spring & Spring Break, and Summer. 3-night minimum Fall, and 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,680 square feetPrime Seaside Location: 3-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate Seaside Residential Beach: West Ruskin Pavilion with access to the largest private residential beach on 30AParking: Designated parking located directly in front of the homeHigh-Speed WiFi: Enhanced WiFi throughout the home with Eero extenders in place and over 500 MB speedOutdoor Amenities: Charcoal grill and enclosed outdoor showerPeacock Alley Linens: Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeResort-Style Amenities Access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service: Thoughtful service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Cart Policy: 2 parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-001936
